thread:
jo: Quick sync — preparing the short release note for docs tomorrow 07:00 PT. PR #8102 has the draft. Need eyes on: JS/Py snippets, changelog blurb, and a small known-issues entry.

clare: I can review JS. Found a streaming chat example still using the legacy `on('data')` pattern; should use `for await (const chunk of client.chat.stream(...))`.

mike: Taking Python. Saw an embeddings example that claims `batch=True` which isn't supported. I'll add a small batching helper and a sync fallback snippet for the known-issue.

sasha: I'll handle link sanity. Linkbot flagged `/docs/optimize#cache-hit` which should be `/docs/optimize#caching-hits`. Adding a redirect and noting it in the release checklist.

jo: Draft announcement lines: 1) Streaming chat + function call ergonomics improved. 2) Batching improvements cut token cost ~25% in benchmarks. Known issue: short streaming batches can yield truncated embedding outputs on some kernels; recommend sync fallback.

clare: Suggest reword to "may produce truncated vectors" and include the sync snippet inline.

mike: Sync snippet for known-issue: `from redwood import Client\nclient = Client()\nemb = client.embeddings.create(model=\"embed-v2\", input=[\"...\"], sync=True)`

docs-bot: Reminder: docs-prbot assigned reviewers @clare @mike @sasha for PR #8102. Please review within 24h.

jo: If all approvals by EOD I'll merge and tag `docs-release/2026-03-23`.

clare: Reviewed + small fixes pushed.

sasha: Redirect rule applied to staging, running linkcheck now.

mike: Approved.

jo: Thanks all — merging after linkcheck green. :thumbsup:
